challenges.title: Cascade
challenges.tagline: Cosmic-ray air showers over the high desert
challenges.summary: An interactive Monte Carlo of cosmic-ray air showers that runs in the browser. Showers are tracked particle by particle, then replayed in 3D over real terrain north of Reno, Nevada, and compared with a citizen observatory's own measurements.
challenges.imageAlt: A 1 PeV proton shower striking the ground under a night sky
challenges.clipAlt: A 1 PeV proton shower replayed from the side: the shower front sweeps down and the ground lights up where particles land

challenges.title: Drumhead
challenges.tagline: Draw a drum, hear its shape
challenges.summary: Draw any shape and play it as a drum, or as a metal plate. Its vibration modes are solved in your browser, sand draws Chladni's figures on the still lines, and two different drums from Kac's famous question sound exactly alike. A listening game, a mode gallery and a validation page against published values come with it.
challenges.imageAlt: The two isospectral twin drums, struck, with vermilion and blue contours of their vibration
challenges.clipAlt: A guitar-shaped drum struck four times: two-ink contours of the membrane ripple and fade

challenges.title: Lightbox
challenges.tagline: A spectral path tracer you can rearrange
challenges.summary: Arrange glass, mirrors, cut gems and gas-discharge tubes, and watch a photograph of them form in your browser. Light is traced one wavelength at a time through measured glass and metal, so prisms make spectra and diamonds have fire without being told to. A twelve-step tour, a spectroscope with a quiz, a real camera and darkroom, and a validation page of 38 measurements against known answers come with it.
challenges.imageAlt: Seven thin beams of white light skim a table, cross behind a glass rod and fan out fringed with colour
challenges.clipAlt: A still life of a glass ball, a wine glass and a gold knot settles from noise; the ball is dragged across the table and the camera orbits
